name: the-anvil-loop
description: A near-empty repo that turns a concept into something an agent can build autonomously and actually get better at.
_comment: The shipped programs (doctor, validate-spec, verify-harness, gate, journal, status)
use only the Node standard library and need no install. That is deliberate: the
framework must run the moment the repo is cloned, before any decision about your
The seven generated tools WILL need dependencies — a headless browser driver, an image
decoder, whatever your engine requires. Phase 0 adds them here. Until then this file
stays empty of dependencies on purpose.
